result.title: FABLE task 001 / F2: bounded finite-sum diagnostic for the symmetric-prime trial (J_L for L=10^3..10^7, cross-validation, drift fits, coincidence and S2-moment diagnostics)
result.status: complete — finite numerical check (plus one exact-algebra identity and one arithmetic-asymptotic sketch); no proof of the arithmetic transfer; no counterexample found; nothing committed; no pre-existing file modified; arXiv fetch egress-blocked so all theorem statements are '(as described by Astra; paper not read)'

claims.statement: Independent matrix-free implementation of A[qm,m]=2 sin((pi/2)log q/log L)/(e sqrt q) and K_L=A^T A+(A^2+(A^T)^2)/2 reproduces Astra's lambda_max(K_L)=3.9492871367 (L=1e3), 4.1058670454 (1e4), 4.2052553801 (1e5) to all ten printed digits; nnz(A) identical (2877, 31985, 343614, 3626619).
claims.evidence: f2_finite_sum.py eigsh on my LinearOperator; residuals 1.3e-15, 4.6e-15, 2.0e-13; f2_finite_sum_results.json

claims.statement: Independently parametrised Gauss quadrature of the stipulated continuum schema gives J=-0.014662375473371 for the fixed rational trial (within 1.6e-15 of Astra's certified enclosure) and -0.015357981703850 for the degree-14 optimum (2e-16). New continuum values: mass-only f at ell=16/15: -0.0215652589; H=1 at ell=16/15: -0.0333607118; H=1 at ell=1: -0.0307564823.
claims.status: numerical continuum integral (floating; not a certificate; tests nothing about arithmetic meaning)

claims.evidence: f2_finite_sum_run.log, f2_finite_sum_run_1e7.log, results JSON; table in report section 4

claims.statement: Drift diagnostic: one-term fit J_inf+c/log L on (1e3,1e4,1e5) gives J_inf=-0.01615 (fixed); two-term fit with c'/log^2 L gives -0.01446 on (1e3,1e4,1e5), -0.01470 on (1e4,1e5,1e6), -0.01476 on (1e5,1e6,1e7); the (1e4,1e5,1e6) two-term fit predicts the out-of-sample 1e7 point to 2.6e-6 (one-term: 6.2e-5). The two-term extrapolation lands within 2e-4 of the schema value for all five vectors and the S2 gain extrapolates to 0.00683-0.00693 vs continuum 0.006903. This is consistent with the schema being the limit but proves no limit; L=T is not a permitted finite instance.
claims.evidence: f2_drift_fit.py, f2_drift_fit_results.json, f2_drift_fit_run.log; report section 5 with explicit non-provability statement

claims.statement: Coincidence terms are large at accessible L: dropping prime powers e>=2 lowers J_L(fixed,1e6) from -0.0339 to -0.0715; also dropping insertions of p into m with p|m ('clean' operator = exact combinatorics of the schema) lowers it to -0.0923; (J_full-J_clean)*log L = 0.52,0.64,0.74,0.81,0.86 still rising at 1e7; the clean sub-sum extrapolates unstably (-0.021 to -0.065). Diagonal piece D is within 4% of M3/I and converged; first-order pieces O, C2 are 13-17% below M2b/I, M2a/I at 1e6. Whether M3 accounts for all leading coincidences is therefore not decidable from finite L.
claims.status: finite numerical check; asymptotic vanishing of coincidence terms argued heuristically (relative size ~ (pi/log L)*sum_p log p/p^2 and (pi/log L)*sum_p log p/(p(p-1))) and left open
claims.evidence: nopp/clean modes and D/O/C2 decomposition in f2_finite_sum.py; report sections 4 and 6

claims.statement: Marked Euler product identities: sum_n d_ell(n)^2 S2(n) n^{-s} = F(s)(log L)^{-2} sum_p (log p)^2 (1-1/E_p(s)) and sum_n d^2 S2^2 n^{-s} = F(s)(log L)^{-4}[sum_p (log p)^4(1-1/E_p) + sum_{p!=p'} (log p)^2(log p')^2 (1-1/E_p)(1-1/E_p')], with F=prod_p E_p, E_p(s)=sum_e d_ell(p^e)^2 p^{-es}; 1-1/E_p(s) = a p^{-s}+O(p^{-2s}).
claims.status: exact algebra (immediate from multiplicativity; no machine check run)

claims.statement: Via Selberg-Delange (recalled; not verified online) the d_ell^2/n-weighted integers n<=L^v have cumulative S2 moments a v^2/((a+1)(a+2)) and a(a+6)v^4/((a+1)(a+2)(a+3)(a+4)), whose v-derivative ratios equal Astra's E_v[S]=v^2/(a+1), E_v[S^2]=(a+6)v^4/((a+1)(a+2)(a+3)); the Euler constant C_ell cancels in every ratio. Finite check: weighted-mean ratios 1.014,1.023,1.028,1.030,1.031 (S2) and 1.203,1.174,1.152,1.135,1.121 (S2^2) for 1e3..1e7 (slow, competing 1/log L corrections); background norm N(L)/[C_ell (log L)^a/Gamma(a+1)] = 1+0.751/log L to 4 digits at all five L.
claims.status: arithmetic asymptotic, sketch (depends on recalled Selberg-Delange theorem; not a full write-up) + finite numerical check
claims.evidence: report section 7; S2_moments_fixed_ell and background_norm_fixed_ell in results JSON; selberg_delange_constant C_ell=0.999124

claims.statement: The leading arithmetic evaluation of the M2 insertion structure (H-shifts (v,S)->(v+u,S+u^2)), the error after normalisation including the short-background range v->0, and the rate at which the prime-power and p|m coincidence terms vanish remain unproved; the finite data give no counterexample to the schema for any of the five vectors.

unresolved: Arithmetic transfer of the stipulated M2/M3 form (two-insertion structure with H-shifts) as an asymptotic of the integer sums, with an error tending to zero after normalisation and including the short-background range v->0 — not addressed by F2 (this is the F1 main obligation).

Proof that the prime-power (e>=2) and p|m coincidence configurations are lower order: numerically they are 10-20% of the first-order pieces at L<=1e7 and decay no faster than 1/log L; only a heuristic size estimate is given.

Whether the schema's rule S->S+u^2 needs correction terms at leading order for inserted primes dividing the background (S unchanged) or prime powers (S->S+(u/e)^2): finite data cannot decide; extrapolation of the full operator is consistent with no correction.
The 1/log L expansion form assumed by the drift fits is unproved; a c''/log^3 L term of order 1 would be invisible at L<=1e7.
Primary source not read (arxiv.org egress-blocked): the admissible-range statement L<=T/(log T)^2 and Theorem 4's coefficient conditions are taken from Astra's description.
Selberg-Delange theorem and the constants sum_p log p/p^2 ~ 0.49, sum_p log p/(p(p-1)) ~ 0.755, Mertens constant E ~ -1.33 are recalled, not verified online.
New continuum values for mass-only, H=1 trials are floating quadrature only (no interval certificate).

Timing/memory: L=1e3 0.1 s/94 MB; 1e4 0.5 s/94 MB; 1e5 4.2 s (eigsh 3.6 s)/112 MB; 1e6 9.9 s/213 MB (all five trials x three operator modes); extra 1e7 point 207 s/1478 MB, 2 cores, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1. Headline: the finite operator as specified drifts toward the stipulated schema values on every tested vector (two-term 1/log L extrapolation within 2e-4, out-of-sample 1e7 prediction within 3e-6), so no finite-sum contradiction of the schema was found; but the coincidence-free sub-sum is far away and unstable, so the finite data cannot settle Astra's question 2, and the S2 moments are shown (sketch) to follow from a marked Euler product plus Selberg-Delange rather than from a Poisson-Dirichlet assumption (question 3, background moments only). Margins remain negative everywhere; nothing moves the half-gap boundary.
